name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A set of rules and reusable skills that teaches AI coding assistants a disciplined way of building software, instead of letting them freestyle.
buyer: This is a developer-only methodology framework with no direct end buyer — it improves how developers work with AI, but isn't itself something a business pays for.
business_use_cases: An engineering consultancy adopts it internally to standardize how their own developers use AI coding agents across client projects.
A dev-tools trainer builds paid workshops teaching teams 'AI-assisted development methodology' using this framework as the curriculum.
A software agency uses it to make AI-generated code more consistent and reviewable across a large contractor pool.

money_ideas.idea: Sell training workshops or certification for teams adopting AI-assisted development methodology built around it.

steal_this: Not a product to clone — it's a free methodology. The real weekend project is a paid half-day workshop teaching a dev team how to use it well.
